$description: Levves colors. Neutrals are Leaves' cool blue-green grays; amber is the one accent.

bg-deep.$description: Deepest layer: the desktop, dimming behind dialogs

bg.$description: The top bar, list backgrounds, the phone's bottom bar

raised.$description: Keys, the selected row in an inactive window

text-faint.$description: Disabled text and decoration only: 3.3:1 on bg, too low for reading

text-soft.$description: The menu bar, secondary text on a selected row

accent.$description: Hiker amber: the primary key, the selection, the focused window's light. One per view

accent-hover.$description: Hover on amber, and the amber key's light edge

warning.$description: Warnings, due soon, usage at 70% and above

title-bar-inactive.$description: Title bar of every other window

edge.$description: The black engraved edge. Containers only: windows, group boxes, lists, readouts, slots

well.$description: Sunken areas: readouts, lists, fields, slots

well-pressed.$description: A key held down, the current tab

field-edge.$description: Outline of fields, toggles and radios

dither-a.$description: Dither base: group headers, status bars, disabled keys

desktop-dither.$description: Dither dots over bg-deep on the desktop

terminal.$description: ANSI colors not covered above; red, green, yellow, blue and white reuse critical, success, warning, info and text

decorative.$description: From the wallpaper, for illustration only

selection.$description: Amber behind the selected row in the focused window

tag-fill.$description: A status tag's fill, in its status color

tag-edge.$description: A status tag's outline, in its status color

edge-light.$description: White, the top-left inner line of a container's engraved edge

edge-shade.$description: Black, the bottom-right inner line of a container's engraved edge

etch.$description: White, the light half of a group box's etched line
